{{CharInfobox |color={{physical color}} |corecolor={{physical color light}} |bordercolor={{physical color dark}} |name=Stephan |jname=ケニヤン |tmname=Kenyan |slogan=no |image=Stephan.png |size=250px |caption=Stephan |colors=yes |eyes=Blue |hair=Auburn |gender=Male |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Unova]] |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} |game=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=BW028 |epname=Oshawott's Lost Scalchop! |java=[[Tomohiro Waki]] |enva=[[Darren Dunstan]] }} '''Stephan''' (Japanese: '''ケニヤン''' ''Kenyan'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is a [[rival]] of {{Ash}} who debuted in ''[[BW028|Oshawott's Lost Scalchop!]]''. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|BW}}==== [[File:Stephan and Ash.png|thumb|left|250px|Stephan and his rival, Ash]] Stephan challenged {{Ash}} to a {{pkmn|battle}} and chose {{p|Blitzle}} as his partner. Ash planned to battle him with {{AP|Pikachu}} but ultimately chose {{AP|Oshawott}}. The battle ended up being postponed because Oshawott lost his [[Scalchop and seamitar|scalchop]]. {{an|Cilan}} politely asks Stephan to wait until the next day to have another battle with Ash. He agreed and said that he'd be training up in the mountains and to come and find him there when they were ready. Ash and {{ashfr}} found Stephan up in the mountains the next day, powering up his Blitzle using a bike-powered generator. Shortly after, he had his second battle with Ash. He ended up losing but was greatly impressed by Ash's skills. The two shook hands and he bid farewell. In ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'', Stephan met up with Ash again in [[Nimbasa Town]] riding on his {{p|Zebstrika}} which had since [[Evolution|evolved]] from Blitzle. He also entered the [[Club Battle]] tournament. In [[BW040|the next episode]], he went up against {{an|Bianca}} who was his first opponent. Using his powerful Zebstrika, he managed to defeat [[Bianca's Minccino]] and advance to the next round. Stephan battled {{an|Iris}} and her {{TP|Iris|Emolga}} with his {{TP|Stephan|Sawk}} in ''[[BW041|The Club Battle Hearts of Fury: Emolga Versus Sawk!]]''. Even with his special strategy of using Sawk's {{m|Close Combat}} to deflect Emolga's {{m|Attract}}, he still lost the battle and was knocked out of the tournament. In ''[[BW042|Club Battle Finale: A Hero's Outcome!]]'', he acted as a judge for Cilan and [[Burgundy]]'s {{pkmn|Connoisseur}} battle to see how well they could evaluate Ash and Iris's battle. Once Ash and Iris's battle concluded, he left Nimbasa Town with the other rivals. In ''[[BW069|Climbing the Tower of Success!]]'', Stephan entered the [[Wishing Bell Festival]] contest with his Sawk. He passed through all of the portions of the contest, including one where he needed to {{pkmn|cosplay|dress up}} as [[Nurse Joy]]. He, along with Ash and [[Ricky]], was able to make it to the final portion of the contest where he was to climb [[Mistralton Tower]] while keeping his {{p|Litwick}} candle from burning out. The three made it to the top but Stephan and Ash were the last two after Ricky's candle was burned out by a {{p|Pidove}}'s {{m|Air Slash}}. Giving it all he had, Stephan crossed the finish line first and was declared the winner of the contest giving him the chance to ring the bell at the top of the tower. [[File:Stephan Wishing Bell Festival.png|thumb|250px|Stephan winning the Wishing Bell Festival]] It had turned out that the Litwick-shaped candle he carried was actually a real Litwick and was what helped him win as it blew out Ash's candle just before they crossed the finish line. Still, {{an|Miles}} declared him the winner and he was able to ring the bell. The wish he made was to win the [[Clubsplosion]] tournament and he accompanied the group to [[Ambiga Town]] where they would all compete. In ''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]'', Stephan entered Sawk in the Clubsplosion and went up against [[Edmund]] in the first round. Though Edmund had a bit of an advantage because the sudden rain activated his {{p|Seismitoad}}'s {{a|Swift Swim}}, Stephan was able to defeat him and advance to the second round. After the battle he was confronted by [[Montgomery]], the winner of the last Clubsplosion, who had tried to convince him that his Sawk's strength could not compete with that of his {{p|Throh}}. Though insulted slightly, Stephan was interested in the prospect of gaining a new rival. In ''[[BW071|Search for the Clubultimate!]]'', Stephan offered to help Ash teach {{AP|Scraggy}} how to make his {{m|Focus Blast}} more accurate by having him battle Sawk. However the training did not happen as Bianca interrupted wanting to poke Sawk's muscles again. In ''[[BW072|A Clubsplosion of Excitement!]]'' he attempted to help Ash again but were distracted from training when they heard crashing in the distance. There he saw Montgomery in the middle of a training session with Throh. He was undoubtedly impressed by Throh's power and wanted him to train with him and Ash but he refused. The next day, Stephan went against his second-round opponent, Cilan and his {{TP|Cilan|Pansage}}. Not even allowing the Connoisseur a chance to evaluate Sawk, Stephan took full control of the battle quickly and, literally, knocked his opponent out of the competition, advancing himself to the semi-final round. He discovered that his next opponent would be Bianca and defeated her again in ''[[BW073|Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!]]'' which got him to the final round as did Montgomery. [[File:Montgomery and Stephan.png|left|thumb|250px|Stephan and Montgomery]] During lunch, Stephan and Sawk were given a special meal made by Cilan to help them in their battle. The others were worried for him feeling that Montgomery's Throh knew one other move that he didn't know about. Stephan only laughed knowing he would do well regardless because he had rung the Wishing Bell. Once the battle began, Stephan did well in anticipating Throh's throwing moves and Sawk was able to parry them. However he did not expect his hidden move, {{m|Bind}}, leaving him to think of something quickly. He thought of using Sawk's {{m|Bulk Up}} then Close Combat to escape which worked well. Near the end of the fray both Pokémon were at their limit and Stephan encouraged Sawk not to give up even when he was down. Just as Throh was about to grab Sawk again, he commanded one last Close Combat which finished off Throh and made himself the champion. After celebrating with Sawk, Montgomery approached him saying that he would win the next time they battled but congratulated him on the victory. The two shook hands and Stephan replied that he would win next time as well. Later on he said his goodbyes to the group and promised Ash a battle the next time they would meet. In ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', Stephan revealed that he was going to enter the [[Vertress Conference]]. In the preliminaries, he chose Zebstrika to battle against [[Radley]] and his {{p|Braviary}} and gained his first win. Stephan appeared in ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'' and battled Ash in ''[[BW106|Strong Strategy Steals the Show!]]''. He lost the battle and was eliminated from the competition. He stayed for the remainder of the league, watching all the other battles. He participated in the closing ceremonies of the Vertress Conference in ''[[BW108|A Unova League Evolution!]]'' and afterwards said farewell to Ash, his friends, and Ash's other rivals. Stephan reappeared in Cilan's flashback in ''[[BW140|Survival of the Striaton Gym!]]''. He also appeared prominently in the ending [[Let's Join Hands]], and made a cameo appearance in the ending credits of ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]''. [[File:Unova Rivals.png|thumb|250px|Stephan in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'']] ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== Stephan reappeared in ''[[JN117|The Fiery Road to Mastership!]]'', watching the [[Masters Eight Tournament]] battle between Iris and {{an|Cynthia}} alongside [[Trip]], [[Alder]], [[Georgia]], and Bianca. ===Character=== Like many of {{Ash}}'s [[rival]]s, Stephan has an intense passion for battling and is always willing to take on any opponent. His overall battle style is to charge the opponent head on with full power, thus he gets noticed for his reckless yet effective style. He can be both stubborn and impatient. His impatience is seen right before he was to battle {{an|Iris}} in ''[[BW041|The Club Battle Hearts of Fury: Emolga Versus Sawk!]]'' where he ran onto the battlefield before their names were called. He also can be extremely competitive as seen when he got into an eating contest with Ash in ''[[BW040|Cilan Versus Trip, Ash Versus Georgia!]]''. Still, he always wants his rivals to get stronger and encourages them to do their best when witnessing them battle. Similarly to [[Butch]], Stephan's name is often mispronounced by other characters as "Steffen", "Steven", or "Stuven" (in the original Japanese version, people have several different pronunciations of his name, with "Keniyan" being the most common). At times, people call him a completely different name. When his name is mispronounced, it causes him to correct them in a mood that ranges from a slight annoyance to a vocal outburst as seen in ''[[BW073|Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!]]''. Whatever his mood may be, he quickly drops it. As of ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', his name has been pronounced correctly, which pleases Stephan, though Ash and his friends now claim to have never mispronounced his name. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Stephan's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: ====On hand==== {{TrainerPoké |main=no |trainer=Stephan |pkmn=Zebstrika |stage1=Blitzle |type1=Electric |img=Stephan Blitzle.png |cap=Stephan's Blitzle |img2=Stephan Zebstrika.png |cap2=Stephan's Zebstrika |epnum=BW028 |epname=Oshawott's Lost Scalchop! |vajp=Kiyotaka Furushima |vaen=Lisa Ortiz |vaennote=as Blitzle |vaen2=Marc Thompson |vaen2note=as Zebstrika |desc=Stephan used {{p|Zebstrika}} as a {{p|Blitzle}} in a battle against [[Ash's Oshawott]], but it kicked off Oshawott's [[Scalchop and seamitar|scalchop]], which ultimately caused the battle to be postponed. However, because of Oshawott's training with the heavy scalchop, Oshawott's speed increased dramatically. Blitzle was eventually defeated after they both crashed into a rock while their Flame Charge and {{m|Aqua Jet}} moves combined into a huge wave of steam. In ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'', it was revealed to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into Zebstrika. Stephan also used it in his first battle in the [[Club Battle]] tournament against [[Bianca's Minccino]] in ''[[BW040|Cilan Versus Trip, Ash Versus Georgia!]]''. Though hit by a barrage of {{m|Double Slap}} attacks, it defeated the Chinchilla Pokémon with Stomp and advanced its {{pkmn|Trainer}} to the second round. In ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', Stephan used Zebstrika at the Vertress Conference in his first match against [[Radley]]'s {{p|Braviary}} and won. He used Zebstrika against [[Ash's Palpitoad]] in the fourth round during ''[[BW106|Strong Strategy Steals the Show!]]'', however it got poisoned by {{m|Sludge Wave}} early on. Despite this, Zebstrika put up a good fight which led to a double-KO. After the competition ended, it returned to [[Mistralton Tower]]. None of Litwick's moves are known.}} ===Achievements=== [[File:Stephan Vitamins.png|thumb|250px|The prize for winning the Clubsplosion]] ====Badges obtained==== This listing is of the [[Badge]]s Stephan has obtained in the [[Unova]] [[region]]: * At least eight Badges (prior to ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'') [[File:Wishing Bell.png|thumb|250px|Stephan as the winner of the [[Wishing Bell Festival]] ringing the Wishing Bell]] ====Pokémon League==== Stephan has competed in the following [[Pokémon League Conference]]s: * [[Vertress Conference]] - Top 16 (''[[BW106|Strong Strategy Steals the Show!]]'') ====Pokémon competitions==== Stephan has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Club Battle]] - Top 8 (''[[BW041|The Club Battle Hearts of Fury: Emolga Versus Sawk!]]'') * [[Wishing Bell Festival]] - Winner (''[[BW069|Climbing the Tower of Success!]]'') * [[Clubsplosion]] - Winner (''[[BW073|Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!]]'') ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{physical color light}}|bordercolor={{physical color dark}} |da=Kasper Leisner
